### 版本能力汇总 / Release highlights

- 标准纯 Objective-C UIKit 工程现在可以通过已有的 `AppDelegate.m` 启动回调接入 balanced/strict iOS 运行时防护，无需将项目改写成 Swift。
- 接入时保留原有启动回调逻辑和 `main.m`；找不到唯一可确认的回调时明确停止，不生成可能缺失防护的产物。
- Swift Confidential 仍仅保护 Swift 字符串，不宣称支持 Objective-C 字面量；纯 OC 工程无需提供 `confidential.yml`。
- 更新 iOS 界面与文档，并增加 Objective-C 调用生成的 Swift 包的构建检查。

Standard Objective-C UIKit apps can now integrate balanced/strict iOS runtime protection through an existing AppDelegate launch callback without rewriting the app in Swift. The integration preserves existing launch logic, fails closed when the callback is ambiguous, and does not claim Swift Confidential protects Objective-C string literals.
